summary: Both legal inputs always contain exactly eight characters and three fixed-width fields, so every call has a constant workload that cannot support meaningful runtime scaling tiers.

replacement_checks.evidence: The remotely accepted implementation parses exactly six fixed-width decimal components in total, performs a fixed number of multiplications and additions, and subtracts the two totals once.

The certificate regression checks both packaged sources against an independent fixed-position oracle for every one of the 86,400 legal clock readings from midnight and to the final second, plus deterministic ordered pairs and all authored cases.
